ev.q: Eighty (94%) patients had not received MMR vaccine.
Forty-four (52%) of the 85 measles patients experienced complications
five health care facilities accounting for 32 (38%) of 85 total cases
kindergarten-entry 2-dose MMR vaccination coverage in Ohio (88.3%) was approximately 5% lower than the national estimate of 93.0%

methods_quotes.q: Suspected measles cases were investigated through patient, health care provider, and child care facility interviews, medical records review, and consultation with health care providers.
Reasons for admission obtained from medical records.
The outbreak was declared over on February 4, 2023, 42 days (two measles incubation periods) after the last reported case.
